name: google_merchant-mcp
description: Google Merchant Center (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing. Every tool maps to a d

platform_mcp_google_merchant_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_MERCHANT_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_google_merchant_client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID of your Google Cloud project (with the Merchant API enabled and the project registered with the Merchant Center account).

platform_mcp_google_merchant_client_secr.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_MERCHANT_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_google_merchant_client_secr.description: OAuth client secret of the same client.

platform_mcp_google_merchant_refresh_tok.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_MERCHANT_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_google_merchant_refresh_tok.description: Refresh token from a one-time consent with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/content by a user of the Merchant Center account; the runtime mints access tokens at https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token.

platform_mcp_google_merchant_data_source.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_MERCHANT_DATA_SOURCE
platform_mcp_google_merchant_data_source.description: API product data source to write to, in the form accounts/<account>/dataSources/<id> (Merchant Center > Data sources, or the Data Sources API); only API data sources can be edited.

platform_mcp_google_merchant_content_lan.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_MERCHANT_CONTENT_LANGUAGE
platform_mcp_google_merchant_content_lan.description: Two-letter content language of your products, e.g. en; part of the product input id <language>~<feedLabel>~<offerId>.

platform_mcp_google_merchant_feed_label.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_MERCHANT_FEED_LABEL
platform_mcp_google_merchant_feed_label.description: Feed label of your products, e.g. US; part of the product input id.

tools.name: me
tools.description: accounts.get: {name, accountId, accountName, adultContent, timeZone, languageCode} of the configured Merchant Center account.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: productInputs.patch on accounts/{account}/productInputs/{language}~{feedLabel}~{offerId} (listing_id = your offerId) without an updateMask, so only the attributes sent (title, description) change. `price` is NOT applied: Merchant API prices are amountMicros (price x 1,000,000 as an integer string), which cannot be derived here; `quantity` has no Merchant Center equivalent.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: productInputs.delete removes the product input (offerId = listing_id) from the configured data source; the product stops serving on Google once processed. Not reversible (insert it again to restore).
